verdict.rationale: Polar runs some billing processes on its own: subscriptions renew automatically, dunning retries failed payments on a fixed schedule, and off-session charges work without the customer present. These are built-in, fixed platform behaviors, not automations a user sets up. Webhooks, SDKs and the MCP server are developer building blocks for building automations elsewhere, and the evidence shows no user-configurable automation or workflow feature in Polar itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
